decisions.question: Keep server Retry-After separate from the exponential retry cap
decisions.chosen: Keep server Retry-After separate from the exponential retry cap
decisions.reasoning: The real pinned SDK schedules a five-second header at two seconds. Current source fixes body hints only. Honor headers up to the existing internal wait budget; surface longer delays with metadata rather than retry early. Local injected-response proof does not attribute live Durable Object storage load.
